primary_sources.title: Anderson, Molina-Paris and Mottola, Cosmological Horizon Modes and Linear Response in de Sitter Spacetime
primary_sources.reviewed: Section I, equations (2)-(3) and the separation of metric-driven and independent state variations; section III, the state-independent local trace anomaly before equation (32).
primary_sources.use: Response/source distinction and anomaly premise. The charged source pullback, stress completion and compatibility consequence are derived here. No Planck-scale exclusion prescription is adopted.

source_access: Primary HTML opened directly; no downloaded-byte digest claimed.
strongest_comparator: The retained index theorem gives compatibility in strong curvature and independent shape-dual sources. The Ward transport theorem reconstructs constraints but does not pull that compatibility back to the original trace/orbit pair or prove which pairs have conserved regular completions.
hardest_step: Retain the induced Q_gamma shape source, identify the full coupled adjoint pairing in the original variables, and prove regular stress completion at both ends without mistaking an arbitrary conserved tensor for a realizable Dirac state.
new_consequence: At each admitted integer thermal harmonic n>=2, smooth compact original pairs have conserved, bolt-regular, zero-outer-flux completions. At least one such pair violates the zero-fast auxiliary compatibility. Conservation and these endpoint conditions alone therefore cannot enforce compatibility. Actual tracefree state variations face the explicit surviving shape-adjoint overlaps.
scope_boundary: Neither the actual adjoint profiles nor the preparation image is evaluated. The independent state source vanishes when no such preparation is admitted; metric-driven response belongs to the operator. No actual Dirac incompatibility, physical instability, nonlinear solution or stable wormhole follows.
regulator_contract: Keep the full original action, paired domain, state, period, flux and common subtraction. Retain all operator residual contacts. No gravitational boundary phase, new finite term or order reduction is selected.
verification_scope: Exact four-dimensional Christoffel divergence and source work; complex weighted Riesz/Schur identities including the omitted-source control; both zero and nonzero shape-adjoint alternatives; Kruskal powers; Green construction versus direct covariant ODE integration at two precisions. Numerical geometry is a fixture, not the actual charged seed or Dirac kernel.
